indicators.label: Net sown area
indicators.rationale: Higher cultivated area means more area may be affected by climate change.

indicators.label: Small & marginal farmers
indicators.rationale: Higher share means more people exposed with fewer resources.

indicators.label: Cross-bred cattle
indicators.rationale: Cross-bred cattle are more productive but more sensitive to climate stress.

indicators.label: Rural population density
indicators.rationale: Higher density means a greater number of people at risk.

indicators.label: SC/ST population
indicators.rationale: SC/ST population is more heavily dependent on natural resources and more exposed.

indicators.label: Women-owned landholdings
indicators.rationale: Women's landholdings are generally smaller and resource-poor.
